diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to requiring the order set to be 'required' based on the fact PF2, which states that the order-set field is changed from optional or unspecified to required. This default setting allowed the check to pass even though the lone decision-maker did not have access to PF2.

C5.why: The pharmacy policy changes glucose monitoring to every hour for the first four hours and changes the order-set field from optional or unspecified to required.
